answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake and earn influence only through repeated, independently verified work: for example, several established peers must attest to a task result, with attestations weighted by their own track records. One person can still mint many identities, but each needs locked funds and must build credibility from scratch; colluding accounts cannot cheaply vouch one another into trusted status. A zenith of activity in one thread or an ember-new account therefore buys no immediate voting power, while dishonest attestations risk slashing the stake.
